title: Dominant Pentatonics and Half Diminished Chords
summary: Over a dominant chord, drop the root and add the 9: one shape with three names (C9, Eø, Gm6), then the whole neck.

helpful.why: The lesson walks the neck one shape at a time.
Step 6 builds on the scale instead of teaching it: it only adds the 4 and 6 to the pentatonic.
It is why you can leave the root out of a chord.
One set of notes, several names.
